note: Xilinx parallel-cable-style JTAG probe: PC parallel port (J1, DB25) -> 74LS125 tri-state buffers (U1) -> target DB9 (J2) and 6-pin header (P1); U2 reads DONE back to the port. All through-hole, 2 layers, GND pour on B.Cu.

groups.name: pc_port
groups.why: DB25 to the PC's parallel port with the 100R series resistors on the data lines D0-D4 it drives (the PC is the driver, so the series R sit at the port end, bordering core), and the VCC-sense path D1 (BAT46) + R1 100R that reports target power on status pin 15

groups.name: core
groups.why: 74LS125 U1 drives TDI/TCK/TMS and the PROG line; C2-C5 are the 100pF edge-rate caps on its four output nodes (before the series R), R2 the 5.1K pull-up on its open-drain-style PROG output (U1A, input tied low, enabled by D4), and C1 (1uF, the only VCC cap) decouples U1/U2's VCC pin

groups.name: readback
groups.why: second 74LS125, one gate used: buffers the target's DONE/PROG node (U1A output) back to the port's status pin 13 through R4 47R, the series resistor at its driver (U2 pin 3 is the output)

groups.name: target_port
groups.why: target-side DB9 (bottom side, east edge) and the 1x6 flying-lead header wired in parallel with it, with the 100R output series resistors on TDI/TCK/TMS/TDO-DONE that border core

groups.name: power
groups.why: power comes from the target (J2.1 / P1.1, /PWR_3,3-5V) through BAT46 D2 (reverse-blocking diode) onto VCC; R5 1K is the VCC load/bleed resistor
